versionHistory.noHistoryYet: No history yet. New versions are saved automatically every few minutes while a page is edited.
versionHistory.autosaveNote: Versions are saved automatically every few minutes while the page is edited.

pageDetail.noShareLinksYet: No links yet — only workspace members can see this page.
pageDetail.noShareLinksPersonal: No links yet. Only you and the people you invite can see this page.
pageDetail.noCommentsYet: No comments yet. Start the discussion.
pageDetail.shareDescription: Anyone with the link can open this page without signing in.
pageDetail.linkCreatedNoCopy: Link created — copy it now, it's shown only once:
pageDetail.readOnly: View only — you don't have edit access to this page.
pageDetail.accessOpen: Everyone who can see this space can open it. Add someone to restrict it to a list.
pageDetail.accessPrivate: Only you can see this page, not even workspace admins. Invite people below to share it; it moves to Shared.
pageDetail.accessShared: Shared by {{owner}} with the people below. Everyone else, workspace admins included, can't see it. Sub-pages are shared too.
pageDetail.accessRestricted: Only the people and teams below (and the workspace super admin) can open this page.

index.emptyStateText: Write specs, meeting notes, and team docs here — and link them to issues on your boards.
index.title: Docs
index.subtitle: Specs, notes, and team knowledge — linked to your issues.

trash.deleteConfirm: "{{title}}" will be permanently deleted. This can't be undone.
trash.trashSubtitle: Pages in the trash can be restored or deleted forever.
trash.trashEmptyHint: Pages you move to the trash show up here.

notionImport.title: Import from Notion
notionImport.intro: In Notion, open a page's ⋯ menu → Export, or Settings → Export all workspace content. Choose HTML to keep page icons, toggles and callouts (Markdown & CSV works too), turn on “Include subpages”, then upload the .zip as downloaded.
notionImport.workspaceHint: Everyone in the workspace can see these pages.
notionImport.privateHint: Only you can see these pages. You can share or move them later.
notionImport.teamHint: Only that team's members and the super admin can see these pages.
notionImport.importing: Importing… a large export can take a minute.
notionImport.tooLarge: That file is over 200 MB. Export a smaller part of the workspace, or upload each “Part” zip separately.

notionMigration.title: Connect to Notion
notionMigration.subtitle: Copy pages from your Notion workspace into Kompast.
notionMigration.chooserHeading: How do you want to bring pages in?
notionMigration.chooseConnectHint: Connect with an integration secret. Pick the pages to import, and Kompast copies them in the background.
notionMigration.chooseZipHint: Use a Notion export you downloaded yourself. Good for a one-off copy.

setup.heading: Before you connect
setup.step1: In Notion, create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations. Give it the “Read content” and “Read user information including email addresses” capabilities.
setup.step2: Copy the integration's secret. You'll paste it below.
setup.step3: Share each top-level page (or teamspace page) you want to import with the integration: open it, choose ⋯ → Connections, and add it. Pages the integration can't see are left out.
setup.tokenHint: Stored encrypted on this server. Only you can see it, and it isn't shown again.

previous.heading: Previous Notion migrations
previous.deleteHint: Imported pages stay where they are. Only the link to Notion is forgotten.

discovering.heading: Reading your Notion workspace…
discovering.body: This can take a minute for a large workspace. You can close this window; it keeps going.

pick.heading: Choose pages to import
pick.description: Check a page to bring it along with everything under it. Choose where each one lands.
pick.truncated: Notion's search stopped early, so some pages may be missing. Share the pages you need and scan again.
pick.empty: No pages are visible to the integration yet. Share pages with it in Notion (⋯ → Connections), then scan again.
pick.nothingSelected: Check at least one page to continue.

review.heading: Review
review.description: Nothing is copied until you start. The migration runs in the background and resumes if it's interrupted.

kept.formatting: Text formatting: headings, lists, quotes, code, toggles and callouts
kept.tables: Tables. Each database becomes a table page with one sub-page per row, holding the row's properties
kept.files: Images and files, copied into Kompast
kept.links: Links between pages, kept as mentions with backlinks

run.waiting: Waiting for the worker to pick it up…
run.failedHint: Pages already copied stay. Retry picks up where it left off.
